answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register by cryptographically burning stake under superlinear cost scaling: the nth identity requires destroying O(n^1.5) native tokens. Even if an automated model writes every verification sonnet to prove compute, its cumulative burn reaches a fatal economic ledge. As marginal identity cost escalates exponentially relative to coordinated reward, the attacker’s expected return drops to an irrecoverable nadir.
